algorithms.cohort_rules: dev first80 train; G8 remainder; retrieval first300 validation; answers first200 retrieval; full first6 answers
algorithms.content_hash: sha256 exact UTF-8; rendered = heading + LF LF + body
algorithms.derivation_hashes: SHA-256; canonical JSON uses sorted keys, ASCII escaping, compact separators; passage list sorted by passage_id without trailing LF; qrels canonical JSONL sorted by query_id with sorted passage_ids and trailing LF; duplicate-group lists canonical JSON without trailing LF
algorithms.eligibility: agent immediately after user; target da != respond_no_solution
algorithms.generation: same retained turns chronologically, identical role labels and separator
algorithms.heading: first span parent_titles texts then title, joined with ' > '
algorithms.heading_only: all run span tags in h1..h6; retained
algorithms.materialization_hashes: SHA-256 of exact private canonical JSONL bytes, including trailing LF; source domain/document/dialogue/turn order, as in the builder
algorithms.qrels: union of target agent references across domains/documents/spans, sorted deduplicated passage IDs
algorithms.query_id_list_hash: sorted query IDs, LF-separated, trailing LF
algorithms.retrieval: current user then previous four individual turns newest first; role: utterance; ' [SEP] '
algorithms.spans: sort (start_sp,end_sp,integer id_sp); maximal consecutive identical-title runs; exact slice
algorithms.truncation: drop oldest history until <=1024 cl100k tokens; overlong current user fails

audits.g8_exclusion_rule: exact retrieval or last-turn hash shared with dev or any validation query
audits.notes: Coordinator's independent 200-random-query probe: 0 gold spans missing from qrel passage bodies. Three target replies also occurred in inputs because the human agent had said the same text earlier in the dialogue; natural repetition, not pipeline target leakage. These probe observations are not an exhaustive corpus audit.
audits.passage_overlap_treatment: shared corpus permitted; no G8 exclusion solely for passage overlap
